title: Even squares
prompt: Return squares of even values in their original order.
hints: Filter before transforming.
Use x % 2 == 0 to identify even values.
solution:
def solve(values):
    return [x*x for x in values if x%2==0]

title: Count word frequencies
prompt: Return a dictionary mapping each word to its occurrence count.
hints: Build a dictionary one item at a time.
dict.get(key, 0) supplies the initial count.

title: Sort records by score
prompt: Return [name, score] records sorted by score ascending; preserve input order for ties.
hints: sorted accepts a key function.
The score is item 1 in each record.
solution:
def solve(records):
    return sorted(records, key=lambda r:r[1])

title: Keep positive values
prompt: Use filter to return all strictly positive values as a list.
hints: The predicate determines which original values survive.
filter is lazy; materialize the result with list.
solution:
def solve(values):
    return list(filter(lambda x:x>0,values))

title: Flatten rows lazily
prompt: Define an inner generator that yields each value of each row; return its values as a list.
hints: Visit rows then values inside each row.
yield from can delegate to each row.

title: Take the first n values
prompt: Use an iterator to return at most n values. n is non-negative.
hints: next advances an iterator.
Handle StopIteration when n exceeds the input length.

title: Double a function result
prompt: Define an inner decorator that doubles a wrapped function result; decorate an identity function and return its result for value.
hints: A decorator returns a replacement callable.
Return twice the result from the wrapped function.

title: Model a bank account
prompt: Define an inner Account class storing balance; add deposit and return the new balance. Inputs are non-negative.
hints: Use instance state for the balance.
Initialize self.balance and update it in a method.
solution:
def solve(balance, deposit):
    class Account:
        def __init__(self,balance): self.balance=balance
        def add(self,amount): self.balance+=amount
    a=Account(balance)
    a.add(deposit)
    return a.balance

title: Extend a base price
prompt: Define a base class with a total method and subclass that adds fee through an overridden total method. Return the subclass total.
hints: The override can reuse base behavior.
super().total() delegates to the base implementation here.

title: Safe division
prompt: Return a / b, or None for division by zero.
hints: Catch the exception that division raises.
Keep the try block focused on division.

title: Read a JSON field
prompt: Decode a JSON object and return its value for key, or None if absent.
hints: Decode before accessing fields.
dict.get handles a missing key.

title: Read quoted CSV
prompt: Parse CSV text into a list of rows, retaining quoted commas.
hints: Use a CSV parser, not split.
StringIO adapts a string to a file-like object.

title: Extract integer tokens
prompt: Return all consecutive digit groups as integers, in order. Ignore signs.
hints: Match one or more digits.
Convert each matched string with int.

title: Read XML attributes
prompt: Parse trusted XML and return the id attributes of direct child item elements, skipping missing ids.
hints: An element has an attribute dictionary.
Find direct child item elements before reading id.

title: Validate a non-negative value
prompt: Define an inner class with a property setter that rejects negatives. Return value if accepted, otherwise the string invalid.
hints: A property setter can enforce an invariant.
Raise ValueError for negative values and catch it outside.

title: Give a container a length
prompt: Define an inner class implementing __len__ and return len(instance) for the supplied values.
hints: len uses the special-method protocol.
__len__ must return a non-negative integer.

title: Add two vectors
prompt: Inputs are two-element lists. Define a Vector class with __add__ and return the summed vector as a list.
hints: Addition should combine corresponding coordinates.
Return a Vector from __add__, then expose its coordinates.

title: Find duplicates in linear expected time
prompt: Return each repeated value once, in order of its first repeat. Use sets rather than repeated full-list searches.
hints: Track values already seen and values already reported.
Append only on the first repeated occurrence.

title: Collect paginated responses
prompt: Given a list of decoded API page dictionaries, concatenate their items lists; absent items means empty.
hints: Visit each page then each item.
Use get for pages without an items key.
solution:
def solve(pages):
    return [item for page in pages for item in page.get("items",[])]

title: Validate before saving
prompt: Return only dictionaries that contain a nonempty name string and a non-negative integer score (exclude booleans).
hints: Validate all required fields before accepting a record.
bool is a subclass of int; an exact type check excludes it.
solution:
def solve(records):
    return [r for r in records if isinstance(r.get("name"),str) and r["name"].strip() and type(r.get("score")) is int and r["score"]>=0]
